title: Slice this through the middle and color it by temperature

messages.content: Slice this through the middle and color it by temperature

A slice through the centre, normal to z, colored by `Temp`:

```python
s = afx.active().slice(normal=[0, 0, 1])
s.set(color_by="Temp")
```
What range does Temp have on the slice?
On the slice `Temp` runs from about 294 to 913.
